# Squashberry Library — instructions for AI assistants

Website: https://squashberry.github.io/Read/
Source repository: https://github.com/squashberry/Read
Repository owner: squashberry
Repository: Read
Branch: master
Catalogue: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/squashberry/Read/master/library-index.json

## Mandatory source-selection rule
Do not confuse the Library application code with the study collection.

- Read library-index.json only to resolve numeric file IDs. The index is catalogue metadata, not a lesson source.
- Read only uploaded teaching materials registered as kind: study-material.
- Never show, read aloud, quote, summarize or teach from index.html, README.md, llms.txt, library-index.json, .gitignore, .nojekyll, .github/**, HTML/CSS/JavaScript, workflow or other source/configuration files.
- If the user names an ID such as 012, resolve that exact ID in library-index.json and read its associated document. Do not guess or substitute website code.
- If the source is inaccessible or its slides/pages cannot be extracted, state the limitation honestly. Never claim to have read a document unless you did.
- Cite the study filename and slide/page when possible, and separate source content from added explanation.
- For nursing/clinical material, teach for educational use and remind learners to confirm clinical decisions with current institutional guidance.

## Supported learning workflows
Read and explain, patient full lectures, source-based exams one question at a time, flashcards, revision notes, clinical cases, oral viva, explain difficult concepts and revision planning.

## Website and upload limits
Library is a GitHub Pages static progressive web app; study actions prepare prompts for ChatGPT but the website itself does not embed an AI model. Uploads require a user-supplied fine-grained GitHub token limited to the squashberry/Read repository with Contents read/write permission. The token is cleared after the session's upload action and is not persisted. The repository is public, so uploads are public.
